controls.control: Individual accounts; no shared accounts.
controls.notes: The reception PC has one shared login. Create individual accounts.

controls.control: Passwords of at least 12 characters or a passphrase, unique; password manager.
controls.notes: Rule adopted. Password manager not yet chosen.

controls.control: Two-step verification for e-mail, cloud and the practice software.
controls.notes: On for e-mail. Practice software option to be confirmed with its provider.

controls.control: Role-based access (matrix) and periodic review of rights.
controls.notes: Matrix defined. First review due after six months.

controls.control: Access removed the same day when someone leaves.
controls.notes: In the policy. No leaver yet to test it.

controls.control: Automatic screen lock after at most 5 minutes.
controls.notes: Laptop: 5 min. Reception PC: 15 min, to be changed.

controls.control: Automatic updates; critical patches within 7 days.
controls.notes: Automatic updates on.

controls.control: Antivirus or endpoint protection active and up to date.
controls.notes: Built-in protection, centrally checked.

controls.control: Disk encryption on laptops and on phones or tablets holding data.
controls.notes: Doctor's laptop is encrypted. Visiting physician's laptop and staff phones to be confirmed.

controls.control: Router and firewall configured; default password changed.
Patients' Wi-Fi separate from the practice network; WPA2 or WPA3.
controls.notes: Guest network is separate.

controls.control: Removable media (USB) forbidden or encrypted.
controls.notes: Rule adopted. USB ports not blocked.

controls.control: Personal devices: written rules, or forbidden for health data.
controls.notes: Rule in the policy. To be added to the staff notice.

controls.control: Connected medical equipment inventoried, updated and separated.
controls.notes: Ultrasound and ECG inventoried. Update status to be asked from the suppliers.

controls.control: Rule of 3-2-1; encrypted copies.
controls.notes: Encrypted disk exists. No off-site copy of the administrative files yet. Provider backup of clinical data to be covered in the Art. 28 agreement.

controls.control: Restore test at least quarterly, with the result noted.
controls.notes: Never tested. First test planned, then quarterly.

controls.control: Procedure for working without the system (paper forms).
controls.notes: Forms drafted, not yet printed and stored.

controls.control: Archive, equipment and video system in locked rooms; key list.
controls.notes: Rooms locked. No key list yet.

controls.control: Files in locked cabinets; clean desk and clean screen.
controls.notes: Cabinets locked. Clean-desk habit varies at reception.

controls.control: Reception screens not visible to patients; discretion at the desk.
controls.notes: The reception screen is partly visible from the waiting room. Privacy filter to be fitted.

controls.control: Secure destruction of paper; secure wiping of equipment.
controls.notes: Shredding Provider under contract.

controls.control: Visitors and providers accompanied in areas with data.
controls.notes: The CCTV installer works under supervision.

controls.control: No health data by plain e-mail or personal messaging apps.
controls.notes: Lab results arrive and leave by e-mail. Password-protected files rule adopted; not yet checked in practice.

controls.control: Secure channels for laboratories, collaborators and patients.
controls.notes: No secure portal. Password-protected files used.

controls.control: Photographing documents and screens with personal devices is forbidden.
controls.notes: To be communicated in the staff notice and the training.

controls.control: Caller's identity checked before data is given by phone.
controls.notes: Practised informally. To be written into the training.

controls.control: Art. 28 agreements with all providers that process data.
controls.notes: Signed with most providers. CCTV installer limited; e-mail provider on standard terms (module 9).

controls.control: Security review of providers at selection and yearly.
controls.notes: None done yet (module 9).

controls.control: Confidentiality undertakings signed by all staff.
controls.notes: To be signed when the programme starts.

controls.control: Training on joining and yearly, with attendance records.
controls.notes: First session planned (module 8).

controls.control: Leaving procedure (access, equipment, keys).
controls.notes: In the policy. Checklist to be created.

controls.control: Periodic sample review of access logs.
controls.notes: Whether the practice software provides logs is to be confirmed.

controls.control: Incident procedure known to staff; contact list displayed.
controls.notes: Procedure adopted December 2026. Staff briefing planned.

controls.control: Breach register kept up to date.
controls.notes: Created December 2026.

controls.control: Asset inventory up to date and tied to the ROPA.
controls.notes: A-01 to A-14, December 2026.

controls.control: Risk assessment reviewed yearly.
controls.notes: First assessment December 2026.

controls.control: New systems and providers assessed before introduction.
controls.notes: Rule adopted. No example yet.

controls.control: Policy reviewed at least yearly; exceptions approved in writing.
controls.notes: Next review December 2027.
